title: A Cat's Little Leap

creativeDirection.objective: Create a charming, wordless 2D animated moment of a cat repeatedly leaping in a calm meadow.
creativeDirection.concept: A ginger cat gathers itself, springs into the air, floats for a gentle beat, and lands softly amid a breezy meadow. Its jumps repeat with slight timing variation.

visualSystem.composition: Open 16:9 meadow with the cat centered and layered natural shapes providing depth.
visualSystem.textureAndMaterials: Clean hand-drawn 2D shapes with subtle layered scenery.

creativeDirection.motionLanguage: Anticipatory crouch, fast spring, gentle arcing airtime, squash-and-stretch landing, expressive tail and breeze-driven grass.
creativeDirection.soundDirection: Continuous quiet wind ambience only; no music, voices or effects.
assumptions: A simple stylized ginger cat design is appropriate.

shots.purpose: Establish the peaceful setting and introduce the cat.
shots.visual: A ginger cat settles into a gentle crouch in a sunlit meadow; distant cloud and grasses drift softly.
shots.framing: Wide 16:9, cat centered with layered landscape.
shots.action: The cat notices something, lowers its body and prepares to jump.
shots.visualProgression: Start: relaxed standing cat. Development: tail sways, ears perk, body lowers. End: poised crouch.
shots.transition: Continuous movement; the cat's crouch leads directly into the launch.

shots.visual: The cat springs into the air, paws tucked, body stretching into a high graceful arc.
shots.action: Cat launches, rises, floats briefly and drops toward the grass.
shots.visualProgression: Start: crouch. Development: quick launch, peak hangtime and falling arc. End: paws almost reach the ground.
shots.transition: Stay with the same uninterrupted jump through descent into ground contact.

shots.purpose: Show a satisfying squash-and-stretch landing and renewed energy.
shots.visual: The cat compresses into the landing, rebounds, flicks its tail and gathers for another leap.
shots.framing: Medium shot with the character dominant.
shots.action: Cat lands with soft squash, stretches back up and prepares a second jump.
shots.visualProgression: Start: descending. Development: contact squash and rebound. End: ready stance.
shots.transition: A light timing beat carries the rebound into a smaller second leap.

shots.purpose: Finish on a second playful leap and calm resolved pose.
shots.visual: The cat performs a smaller second jump, lands, sits contentedly as grass ripples around it.
shots.framing: Wide composition returning to the opening visual grammar.
shots.audio: Wind ambience fades very slightly only at the final two seconds.
shots.visualMethod: Original 2D animation in the dedicated composition.
shots.action: A smaller leap resolves into a relaxed seated cat.
shots.visualProgression: Start: poised to jump. Development: shorter arc and landing. End: calm seated pose.
shots.transition: Settle the final landing into a held seated pose, then gently fade out.

acceptanceCriteria: A clearly recognizable cat is visibly animated jumping with believable anticipation, airtime and landing.
The animation is continuous and expressive, not a slideshow.
Soft wind ambience is audible continuously for the entire 20 seconds.
A new dedicated Remotion composition is used by the render request.

renderStrategy.rationale: The brief needs a bespoke 2D character performance and a clean wordless full-frame visual language; none of the existing registered compositions matches this story.
requiredCapabilities: Frame-driven squash-and-stretch jumping and expressive tail movement
Layered meadow environment with breeze motion
renderStrategy.fallback: Do not substitute another composition. Fix the dedicated JumpingCat composition or report the render blocked.

acceptanceCoverage.rationale: Dedicated shots explicitly show launch, peak, descent, squash and rebound.
